ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-22 created. Severity=P1. Origin: hosted API us-west-2. Timeline doc: https://internal/incident/INC-2026-03-22

sam: Quick thoughts — statuspage should be short & non-technical. Propose: publish public notice now, email impacted customers within 48h, full RCA in 5-7 business days. Offer enterprise customers private RCA earlier on request. :thinking_face:

sam: Draft statuspage text:
```markdown
We experienced a service interruption affecting text generation in us-west-2 between 03:12–03:46 UTC. Impact: some API requests returned 5xx errors or timed out. We have restored service and are monitoring. A follow-up with root cause and remediation plan will be posted within 7 business days.
```

asha: CS input: segment comms — public statuspage + short customer email for self-serve; private detailed summary for enterprise + offer 1:1 sync. Need legal sign-off for any RCAs that include customer identifiers. Also, let's give AEs a one-page talking points doc.

Leo/SRE: start recurring incident-pattern tracker; weekly cadence.

leo: I'll own the recurring pattern tracker. I'll spin up a shared sheet and a simple alert rule to flag repeated root causes. Tracker link will be posted here when ready.

sam: Revised statuspage + email subject line suggestion:
```text

Body: We experienced a service disruption affecting some API calls on <date>. Impact and mitigation summary... We'll follow up with technical details within 7 business days. Contact your AE for an earlier briefing.
```

asha: For enterprise outreach, recommend offering interim summary call within 24–48h for top 20 customers. Use checklist: impact, mitigations, timeline, next steps. I'll prep the AE briefing notes.

maria: Good. Owners & deadlines recorded. I'll create a follow-up recurring thread for the RCA draft review. Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept your tasks. I'll update incident tracker and update customers once legal confirms redaction policy.
